movie_title: What's on your 'to-do' list? 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English! 
Pay bills, clean the house... t

vocabulary.definition: a list of tasks that need to be completed
vocabulary.example: I always start my day by making a to-do list to stay organized.
Effective administration is crucial for the smooth running of any business.
Cleaning the house is my least favorite chore.
I tend to procrastinate studying for exams until the last minute.

vocabulary.definition: a business that provides essential services like electricity or water
vocabulary.example: Our utility company increased the rates for electricity this month.

vocabulary.definition: people who take pleasure in completing tasks efficiently
vocabulary.example: My colleague is a super-doer who finishes all his assignments ahead of schedule.
